# Lawnchair Mod for MIUI / AOSP **Lawnchair as a system launcher on MIUI or AOSP, with extra options.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/stargazers)
> [!WARNING] > **Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated.** It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. ## Features - LawnExtension app to control more preferences - Switch the themed-icon pack - Works on MIUI and AOSP (you choose during install) ## Requirements - MIUI 12–13 or AOSP, Android 11/12 - Magisk ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs. ## Screenshots

Lawnchair Mod for MIUI / AOSP

Lawnchair as a system launcher on MIUI or AOSP, with extra options.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/stargazers)

> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users.

Features

  • LawnExtension app to control more preferences
  • Switch the themed-icon pack
  • Works on MIUI and AOSP (you choose during install)

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 12–13 or AOSP, Android 11/12
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Lawnchair_Mod/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs.
